log.open.description: The first line of every event file.

log.dropped.description: A range of seq that the writer refused; it explains the gap. channel is other for the events of the levels error, warn and info and debug for the events of the levels debug and trace; it is stored in the main file.

log.rotated.description: A file was closed as the generation with this number and a new file started; no generation is removed.

log.policy.description: The policy of the event log that is now in force: source is default when no policy file exists and file when the policy file holds it; classes holds the least severe level that is stored for each class. The first policy of a writer and every change of it are stored; the same policy again is not.

log.gated.description: The number of events of the class and the level that the gate of the host refused since the earlier report, so no event is lost without a count.

sidecar.files.start.description: The sidecar started and reads requests.

sidecar.files.exit.description: The sidecar ends with this exit status: 0 when its input closed, 1 for a failure.

sidecar.files.failure.description: A failure ended the sidecar: a request line that is not valid, a reply that cannot be written, or a read error.

sidecar.files.panic.description: A goroutine panicked; the process ends with status 2.

sidecar.files.request.description: A request was answered; the cids are those of the request line, and error names a failed request as <code>: <text>. The text of a write is not stored.

sidecar.files.watch_start.description: A watch of a directory or a file started; path is relative to the project folder.

sidecar.files.watch_change.description: A watched directory or file changed and the sidecar reported it.

sidecar.files.watch_end.description: A watch ended; reason is replaced, closed, input closed or start failed.

sidecar.files.watch_failed.description: A watch failed on its own or did not stop; the sidecar reported the error to the surface.

sidecar.files.git.description: One call of git; error is the exit status of git as the code. A folder outside a repository answers 128, which the request reports as an empty status.
